meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 能够根据用户提供的基因表达数据（如单细胞或批量RNA-seq），调用 arboreto 库的 GRNBoost2 或 GENIE3 算法，推断转录因子与目标基因之间的调控关系，并输出包含调控重要性分数的网络表格。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析转录组数据、推断基因调控网络，或提供基因表达矩阵和转录因子列表时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GRNBoost2 分析这批单细胞RNA-seq数据，识别调控网络。
say.note: Claude 将运行 arboreto 并返回调控链接表格。

say.text: 我有 bulk RNA-seq 表达矩阵和转录因子列表，请推断调控关系。
say.note: Claude 使用 TF 过滤选项执行 GRNBoost2。

say.text: 对比 control 和 treatment 条件下的基因调控网络有何不同。
say.note: Claude 会分别推断并输出两个网络的差异。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data (e.g., single-cell or bulk RNA-seq) using arboreto's GRNBoost2 or GENIE3 algorithms, identifying transcription factor-target gene relationships and returning a network table with importance scores.
howto.when_en: This skill is triggered when the user asks to analyze transcriptomics data, infer gene regulatory networks, or provides an expression matrix and transcription factor list.

say_en.text: Analyze this single-cell RNA-seq data with GRNBoost2 and infer the regulatory network.
say_en.note: Claude will run arboreto and return a table of regulatory links.

say_en.text: I have a bulk RNA-seq expression matrix and a TF list, please infer the regulatory interactions.
say_en.note: Claude performs GRNBoost2 with TF filtering.

say_en.text: Compare the gene regulatory networks between control and treatment conditions.
say_en.note: Claude infers each network and highlights differences.
